title: Carousel Content Package
description: DC-003-I032.10.1 — the final CEO-approved production specification for one carousel, authored entirely upstream (Claude Cowork) and approved by the CEO BEFORE it ever reaches Claude Code. A genuinely new, independent object — deliberately NOT a variant or extension of social-media-package.schema.json (that object is upstream, AI-generated, PRE-approval; this object is downstream, human-authored-and-approved, and carries no llm_model/prompt_version-style generation provenance at all). By the time Claude Code holds a Carousel Content Package, no editorial or creative decision remains: every field here is either copied through verbatim by downstream stages or checked only for internal, mechanical consistency (does a phrase exist verbatim in its own slide's text, does the positional template sequence match) — never rewritten, shortened, or reinterpreted. Always exactly 7 slides in a fixed positional sequence: cover_black, content_white, content_orange, content_white, content_orange, content_white, close_black. Immutable after creation: no update path exists in this milestone (no revision/correction mechanism is implemented for CCP V1 — see this milestone's own report). Unrelated to and never referencing social-media-package.schema.json/production-package.schema.json/editorial-package.schema.json — this object stands on its own, sourced from an article title/reference, not a DC-003 editorial_package_id.

package_type.description: Self-documenting, fixed today — reserved for a future sibling package_type without inventing a second object family prematurely.

package_version.description: The CONTENT-CONTRACT version this record was authored against (the canonical seven-slide, four-template sequence defined in this milestone) — deliberately distinct from `schema_version` below, which is this JSON schema's own structural version. A future carousel sequence/template-family change would introduce package_version "v2" (and very possibly a new schema alongside it), independent of whether this schema's own structure also needs to change at the same time.

carousel_content_package_id.description: Machine-generated, independent of every other DC-003 identifier — mirrors the ep_/sm_/pp_ convention. Deliberately not human-assigned (unlike content-asset.schema.json's own asset_id) since, unlike a Content Asset, nothing about this identifier is meant to be recognisable/curated by hand.

source_article_reference.description: An opaque upstream reference to the source article (e.g. a Cowork document identifier or URL) — never interpreted, never dereferenced by this pipeline. Null when no such reference is available.

industry_name.description: e.g. "Real Estate" — the industry this carousel targets.

industry_series.description: e.g. "Real Estate Industry Series" — the label rendered on-slide. Must equal every slide's own `industry_series` value exactly (checked mechanically at construction, not merely documented) — the same "flat value and per-slide value must stay identical" discipline social-media-package.schema.json's own headings[]/slides[].heading pair already established.

total_slides.description: Always exactly 7 for package_version "v1" — the canonical sequence is fixed, never caller-configurable.

slides.description: Exactly 7 entries in the fixed positional sequence: [0] coverSlide (cover_black), [1] contentSlide (content_white), [2] contentSlide (content_orange), [3] contentSlide (content_white), [4] contentSlide (content_orange), [5] contentSlide (content_white), [6] closeSlide (close_black). Position determines template — never inferred from content, never caller-chosen.

approval.description: This object represents ONLY an already-approved package — there is no draft/review lifecycle in this schema (mirrors social-publishing-manifest.schema.json's own identical `approval.approved: const true` precedent). `approved_by`/`approved_at` describe the CEO's real, external approval event, which happened upstream in Cowork BEFORE this record ever reaches Claude Code — never the moment this record was ingested into DC-003 (see `created_at` for that).

production_authority.description: DC-003-I032.10.1 — enforceable contract behaviour, not decorative metadata: every value here is schema-locked via `const`, so a record claiming otherwise fails validation outright, and the domain factory (carousel-content-package.mjs) never accepts this object as caller input at all — it is always stamped internally with exactly these values, the same discipline social-media-package.mjs already applies to its own `corrections: []` default.

publishing_authorized.description: Always false for this production contract — publishing is a separate, later, explicitly-authorised act (see social-publishing-manifest.schema.json), never implied by carousel approval.

created_at.description: When this record was ingested into DC-003 — distinct from approval.approved_at (the CEO's real, earlier, external approval event).

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of every other field on this record, computed by createCarouselContentPackage() immediately before the record is frozen — mirrors every other domain object's own checksum field exactly.

image.description: Claude Code never sources, generates, or chooses an image — this object either names an already-approved asset or explicitly states none is intended. DC-003-I032.10.1 deliberately implements `mode` "none"/"provided" only; a future "generate" mode is structurally anticipated by this being a closed enum (extend deliberately, not implicitly) but is NOT implemented, tested, or reachable in this milestone.

asset_reference.description: An opaque reference to an already-approved image asset (e.g. a local fixture path or an upstream asset handle) — never interpreted, never dereferenced, never used to generate or search for anything. Required (non-null, non-empty) when mode is "provided"; required null when mode is "none" (checked mechanically by the domain factory, not only by this schema's own conditional below).

direction.description: Optional descriptive provenance text retained from the upstream approval — informational only, never used by Claude Code to generate, search for, or select an asset.

emphasisInstruction.description: DC-003-I032.10.1 — a single, mechanical emphasis instruction. `phrase` must be a literal (normalised) substring of the slide's own headline/body — verified deterministically by the domain factory, never chosen or inferred by Claude Code. See this milestone's own report for the exact normalisation rule and the overlap-rejection rule.

contentSlide.description: Covers both content_white (slide positions 2/4/6) and content_orange (positions 3/5) — the domain factory enforces which template is legal at which position, and that content_orange slides always declare image.mode "none" and image_layout "none" (that variant's own fixed no-image design), never at the schema layer alone.
